messages:
Sam (AE): Kicking off VeloxBridge migration thread. Need compat story for headers, streaming partials, and billing deltas. Can we sync tomorrow? @Priya @Lena
Lena (Solutions Eng): Tomorrow works. Please send 25 priority prompts and their API subset. Also confirm header names (vb-session?).
Omar (VeloxBridge-Eng): We'll upload spec + prompts today. We use vb-session affinity and delta-mode streaming (partials with is_final).
Priya (SE): We can emulate is_final in a compat facade. Main parity risks: tokenizer mismatches, trailing whitespace, and punctuation normalization.
Alex (SRE): Staging: allocating 10.200.40.0/26. Need VeloxBridge egress IPs. Dedicated pool lead time ~18 business days.
Jordan (PM): I'll prepare cost comparison (hosted/dedicated/private) and a decision rubric for output variance tolerance.
Sam (AE): Sales ask: 6-month burst pool + blended token rate during peaks. Need clarity on billing when fallbacks occur.
Priya (SE): Billing note: reserved throughput billed monthly; tokens consumed by fallback models charged at that model's rate. We'll model scenarios.
SecurityBot: Posted security questionnaire link: https://redwood.internal/sec/q/veloxbridge-2026 :lock:
Omar (VeloxBridge-Eng): We require BYOK + EU KMS for EU traffic and 365d encrypted audit logs.
Priya (SE): Private deploy supports BYOK and configurable log retention. Will confirm retention tiers with Compliance.
Lena (Solutions Eng): Quick shim mapping for demo: vb-session -> X-Session-Id, delta-mode:true -> Accept: text/event-stream. Also adding a pre-tokenize normalize step.
Priya (SE): Expect ~5-12% token delta due to their legacy tokenizer; we'll provide a token-normalizer to align billing.
Sam (AE): Next: VeloxBridge upload (done), Redwood to run parity pass (Priya/Lena), SRE staging (Alex), commercial draft (Jordan). I'll send the calendar invite.
